checkedAlternates.risk: Apollo 12 astronauts visited Surveyor 3 on the Moon.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Surveyor 3 was a robotic US Surveyor lander (group-2) visited by Apollo 12’s Intrepid (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Aquarius never landed on the Moon.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Aquarius was the Apollo 13 Lunar Module (group-3), serving as the crew’s lifeboat.
